description: This file provides various debugging backends and utility functions for TorchDynamo, including backends for eager execution, TorchScript, invoke_subgraph, and several testing 'error' backends. It also includes classes and functions for explaining and analyzing graph breaks and operations during compilation.

classes.name: ExplainOutput
classes.description: Data class capturing detailed information about Dynamo's graph explanations, including graphs, break reasons, operation counts, and additional info for debugging purposes.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] make_eager_backend_with_torch_function_mode( mode: torch.overrides.TorchFunctionMode, )
methods.description: Creates an eager runtime backend that applies specified TorchFunctionModes during tracing.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] make_eager_backend_with_torch_function_modes( modes: Iterable[torch.overrides.TorchFunctionMode], )
methods.description: Helper to create a backend that applies multiple TorchFunctionModes in a trace context.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] invoke_subgraph_inner_compiler( subgraph: torch.fx.GraphModule, example_inputs: list[torch.Tensor] )
methods.description: Wraps a subgraph in an invoke_subgraph HOP for AOTAutograd to trace subgraphs as invoke_subgraph HOPs.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] invoke_subgraph( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, fake_tensor_inputs: list[torch.Tensor], **kwargs: Any )
methods.description: Backend that wraps forward/backward graphs in invoke_subgraph HOP for recursive tracing scenarios, relying on AOTAutograd.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] boxed_nop( fx_g: torch.fx.GraphModule, example_inputs: list[torch.Tensor] )
methods.description: Creates a no-op backend that simply calls the original GraphModule, with support for debug interpreter.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] boxed_nop_with_mode( fx_g: torch.fx.GraphModule, example_inputs: list[torch.Tensor], *, mode: torch.overrides.TorchFunctionMode, )
methods.description: Wraps a GraphModule in a no-op backend while running with a specified TorchFunctionMode.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] fake_crossref_boxed_nop( fx_g: torch.fx.GraphModule, example_inputs: list[torch.Tensor], ignore_op_fn: Optional[Callable[[torch._ops.OpOverload], bool]] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a backend that wraps in CrossRefFakeMode, ignoring certain ops based on a filter.

methods.name: bool ignore_builtins(op: torch._ops.OpOverload)
methods.description: Filter to ignore built-in operators in CrossRefFakeMode.

methods.name: Callable[[torch.fx.GraphModule,list[torch.Tensor]],Callable[...,Any]] get_nop_func()
methods.description: Dynamically returns a no-op function based on the current fake tensor cross-reference configuration.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] aot_eager( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, fake_tensor_inputs: list[torch.Tensor], fw_compiler: Optional[Callable[..., Any]] = None, bw_compiler: Optional[Callable[..., Any]] = None, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Runs AOT Autograd with boxed nop compiler for debugging, returning a Callable.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] aot_eager_decomp_partition( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, fake_tensor_inputs: list[torch.Tensor], **kwargs: Any )
methods.description: Partitions a graph with TorchInductor decompositions replaced by nop, useful for isolating errors.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] aot_eager_decomp_partition_with_mode( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, fake_tensor_inputs: list[torch.Tensor], mode: Any, **kwarg: Any, )
methods.description: Same as above but runs with a specified TorchDispatchMode.

methods.name: Callable[...,Any] aot_eager_decomp_partition_crossref( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, fake_tensor_inputs: list[torch.Tensor], **kwargs: Any )
methods.description: Partitions with fake tensor cross-ref config respecting current setting.

methods.name: aot_ts
methods.description: AOT Autograd with TorchScript backend, used for both NNC and NVFuser.

methods.name: torch.fx.GraphModule relu_runtime_error_TESTING_ONLY( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, example_inputs: list[torch.Tensor] )
